WITH
    updated AS (
        UPDATE trip_fuel f
        SET
            trip_id = t.trip_id
        FROM
            trips t
        WHERE
            f.fiskeridir_vessel_id = t.fiskeridir_vessel_id
            AND f.trip_id IS NULL
            AND COMPUTE_TS_RANGE_PERCENT_OVERLAP (t.period, f.period) >= 0.8
        RETURNING
            f.trip_id,
            fuel_liter_used
    )
UPDATE trips_detailed t
SET
    trip_fuel_liter_used = u.fuel_liter_used
FROM
    updated u
WHERE
    t.trip_id = u.trip_id
